sloka: भरते ब्रुवति स्वप्नम् दूताः ते क्लान्त वाहनाः ।प्रविश्य असह्य परिखम् रम्यम् राज गृहम् पुरम् ॥२-७०-१॥
transliteration: bharate bruvati svapnam dūtāḥ te klānta vāhanāḥ ।praviśya asahya parikham ramyam rāja gṛham puram ॥2-70-1॥

translations.english: While Bharata was relating his dream, the mounted messengers (from Ayodhya) with their weary horses entered the lovely city of Rajagriha surrounded by an impassable moat. There they met the king of Kekaya country and his son, Yuddhajit and were received with honour. Touching the feet of the king with reverence, they said to Bharata:
